tool_args.rationale: The observations combine a sink-dependent short-horizon response with a delayed reversal. Numerically fit competing smooth couplings of a siphon base and dual-timescale adaptation, then use fresh confirmation to test the best-fitting candidate.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It was refuted on fresh confirmation; the revised candidates include a local branch and explicit coupling alternatives.
Its archived positive-forcing form does not naturally explain the observed long-horizon sign reversal.
The acquired 11 training rows already cover short, intermediate and long horizons; test a revised mechanism before buying more data.
